title: The Heroic Rescue and Nano's Awakening — Part 4

series.summary: Rentaro dives through the turbulent swells and rescues Shizuka, carrying her safely to the deck. Watching Rentaro risk his life, Nano questions her own cold, detached logic of efficiency, only for Rentaro to warmly teach her that in the Rentaro Family, love is never divided, but infinitely shared.

segments.description: Rentaro powers through the churning waves, scoops Shizuka into his arms, and swims toward safety.
segments.voiceover_text: Powering through the brutal current, Rentaro scoops Shizuka into his protective embrace, swimming furiously toward the safe pool shallows.

segments.description: Rentaro carries a coughing, tearful Shizuka onto the deck, checking her face with tender relief.
segments.voiceover_text: Carrying the trembling, tearful Shizuka onto dry deck, Rentaro gently wraps her in warm towels, overflowing with immense relief.

segments.description: Nano watches Rentaro's total devotion, her stoic analytical expression giving way to deep contemplation.
segments.voiceover_text: Observing Rentaro's selfless heroism, Nano feels her analytical worldview fracture, realizing human devotion completely defies cold mathematical efficiency.

segments.description: Rentaro looks into Nano's eyes, smiling warmly as he explains how much she means to him and everyone.
segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro tenderly reassures Nano that loving multiple partners never divides affection, but multiplies warmth so everyone is completely cherished.

segments.description: The girlfriends smile and hug Shizuka, enjoying the waterslides together as joy returns to the group.
segments.voiceover_text: Relief and joyous cheer return as the girlfriends rally together, sliding down colorful water tubes with renewed happiness.
